events.verdict: Booker (PHX) places and slightly extends his right hand against the front of Lopez (MIL), but the contact is marginal in nature and does not affect Lopez's ability to defend.
RLB shows Lopez (MIL) makes incidental "high-five" contact with Booker's (PHX) hand after he releases the shot attempt.
RLS shows Middleton (MIL) makes clean contact with the ball and then makes contact with the part of Ayton's (PHX) hand that is on the ball.
[Observable in enhanced video] LAR shows Ayton (PHX) establishes his right foot as his pivot upon returning to the floor, which he slides prior to making the pass.
Warren (PHX) places his left hand against Middleton's (MIL) side and makes marginal contact that does not affect his SQBR during the drive.
LLS shows Booker (PHX) makes contact with Middleton's (MIL) left arm after his gather and affects the shot attempt.
Lopez (MIL) makes contact with Warren's (PHX) left arm after the gather and affects his driving shot attempt.
Booker (PHX) places his hands against Bledsoe's (MIL) hips and briefly grasps his jersey, but does not affect his FOM as he moves to receive the inbound pass.
Booker (PHX) reflexively places his arm around Antetokounmpo's (MIL) midsection as the pick is set and creates contact that is tactile in nature.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) places his hands against Booker's (PHX) backside as he sets the pick and makes marginal contact that does not affect his ability to defend.
Lopez (MIL) establishes himself in a screening position in Warren's (PHX) defensive path and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Warren (PHX) makes incidental contact with the part of Middleton's (MIL) hand that is on the ball during his upward shooting motion.

RAR shows Lopez (MIL) makes contact to Warren's (PHX) face during his upward shooting motion. The contact occurs prior to Lopez blocking Warren's shot attempt.
LAR shows Ayton (PHX) legally places his forearm to the front of Antetokounmpo (MIL) and makes clean contact with the ball as Antetokounmpo begins to gather.
